topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation without introducing new cells or molecules.

topics.label: Principles of Innate Immune Recognition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the conceptual foundation of how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage through conserved molecular patterns and germline-encoded receptors.

topics.label: Pattern Recognition Receptor Families and Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the specific receptor families and downstream intracellular cascades responsible for sensing pathogens and triggering inflammatory pathways.

topics.label: Cellular Inflammatory Responses and Systemic Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the cellular trafficking and physiological consequences that unfold once sentinel cells activate an inflammatory response.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation and Post-Inflammatory Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the immune system halts active inflammation and manages subsequent tissue outcomes ranging from healing to chronic containment.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the topic for the following lecture.
